back: The growing interconnection of the world's economies through trade, capital, people, technology and information.

front: Give four causes of changes in globalisation.
back: Changes in trade restrictions; transport costs; communication costs; the movement of MNCs (also capital flows, political events).
More competition from imports and foreign firms: lower prices and more choice, but some inefficient local firms close.

front: Effect of globalisation on the environment?
back: More production and transport raise pollution and emissions; but cleaner technology and standards can spread.
More movement of workers: host countries gain skills; source countries gain remittances but suffer brain drain.

front: Effect of globalisation on income distribution?
back: Can reduce poverty overall, but gains go mainly to skilled workers and capital owners, so inequality within countries may widen.
Yes: higher trade barriers, conflicts, pandemics and higher transport costs can slow or reverse it.
